name: 720 Degrees
notes: Recovered by the lead layout — this manual prints its designators before the device rather than after it, which extract_ic_locations could not read until 2026-09. The row states its device twice, as a stock number and in the description, and is taken only when the two agree.
Column-first designators, the post-1983 Atari convention, recorded in grid.transposed rather than inferred: 2L and L2 name the same cell and only the silkscreen says which is printed.
No component-location drawing has been read. The grid spacing is nominal — the designators are real but nothing here has measured the board.
conflicts: 1 row rejected on the device name.
